"import cadquery as cq

# Plate: 160 (X) x 100 (Y) x 12 (Z), centered on origin in XY, base at z=0
L = 160.0
W = 100.0
T = 12.0
FILLET_R = 12.0   # all four vertical (Z-parallel) edges
HOLE_D = 10.0     # four through holes, axes parallel to Z
HX = 58.0         # hole centers at (+/-58, +/-28)
HY = 28.0

# Reliable sequence: rect + extrude -> fillet vertical edges FIRST -> then drill holes
part = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .rect(L, W)
        .extrude(T)
        .edges("|Z")
        .fillet(FILLET_R)
        .faces(">Z")
        .workplane()
        .pushPoints([(-HX, -HY), (HX, -HY), (-HX, HY), (HX, HY)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0)
        .cutThruAll())

shape = part.val()
cq.exporters.export(shape, "part.step")"
